text: Reminder - please put your Friday outputs in /Drafts by 1100 so we have time to review before Hugh joins.

Quick methodology note on the Friday outputs while you're drafting - watch the finding/question duplication. Worst pattern I keep flagging on pre-IC briefings is when the team takes the same point and frames it as both a headline finding and an open question. They're meant to be different beasts: findings are what we now believe; open questions are what we still don't know and need confirmatory to resolve. If a so-called finding has a clear unknown sitting underneath it, it's an open question, not a finding - pick one and move on. The three findings and three open questions should not paraphrase each other across the two groups.
Noted. I'll do a pass to make sure none of the three findings restate an open question.
Same on the model side, will keep findings and questions cleanly separated.
Good. Tight separation is what Hugh will be reading for.
Drafts are in /Drafts. Ready for review.
